title: Monthly Rental, Book Value and Unit Services under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease
content:
# Master Lease Agreement — Rental Terms of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

## Clause 1 — What the schedule records

Each unit schedule records the monthly depreciation percentage for the unit's vehicle class (from the depreciation table by class), the tier's lease rate and monthly management fee, and a term no longer than the tier's longest scheduled term. The upfit cost may not exceed the tier's maximum upfit percentage of the chassis cost, and the TRAC residual may not be lower than the lowest TRAC residual percentage of the capitalized cost.

## Clause 2 — The monthly rental

Each month's rental is the total of:

1. **the depreciation** — the capitalized cost multiplied by the monthly depreciation percentage, divided by 100 and rounded to the nearest cent;
2. **the lease charge** — the book value before that month's depreciation, multiplied by the lease rate and divided by 1200, rounded to the nearest cent;
3. **the monthly management fee**; and
4. **sales tax**, where the title state taxes rentals.

The first rental follows the tier's first-rental rule. Invoices issue on the tier's invoice day and are consolidated per master agreement where the tier bills on one consolidated invoice.

## Clause 3 — Book value

The capitalized cost is booked as book value when the unit goes into service, and each month's depreciation reduces it.

## Clause 4 — Unit services

Registration renewals are handled for the tier's registration administrative fee only where the tier offers the registration renewal service. A lapse below the tier's minimum liability coverage brings the force-placed insurance fee each month until proof of coverage is received. Whether a unit may be swapped under the same schedule is governed by the tier's unit-substitution term.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A unit with a hypothetical capitalized cost of 30000, a monthly depreciation percentage of 2.0, a lease rate of 7.5, a monthly management fee of 30, a book value before the month's depreciation of 24000 and a title state that does not tax rentals:

| Part | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Depreciation | 30000 multiplied by 2.0, divided by 100 | 600.00 |
| Lease charge | 24000 multiplied by 7.5, divided by 1200 | 150.00 |
| Management fee | as recorded | 30.00 |
| Sales tax | not taxed in this title state | 0.00 |
| Rental | total of the parts | 780.00 |

After the month, the book value falls by the 600.00 of depreciation, to 23400.
